company.shortDescription: LivLyt is a modern workforce tech platform, enabling companies across the globe to manage SaaS, IT, & devices for teams - all in one place.
company.description:
LivLyt is a modern IT platform, to manage SaaS & Devices, and optimize tech spends. LivLyt platform helps companies to track SaaS usage and optimize spends, manage device inventory and employee profiles, secure devices with MDM, get on-demand IT support, & device leasing solution - all under one roof.
We help you save costs on tech through actionable insights on your SaaS and device spends per employee. Manage your company’s device inventory, control & secure devices using Mobile Device Management (MDM) solution, get on-demand IT support with a Virtual IT room & save IT capex with leasing services.
